title: Håstad seed distribution
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\delta\in[0,1]$. Choose $x$ and $y$ independently and uniformly from $\{\pm1\}^n$, and choose $b$ uniformly from $\{\pm1\}$. Then draw $z$ from the noise kernel with parameter $1-\delta$, applied to the vector whose coordinates are $b x_i y_i$, and return $(x,y,b,z)$.
